site.name: Nour Abou Zour
site.intro: Every guide from my reels in one place. Search the word you commented, watch the reel again, and download the PDF.

guides.title: Agent Reach: give Claude access to the whole internet
guides.description: A free, open-source tool that lets Claude read YouTube, X, Reddit, LinkedIn, Instagram and more without paying for API keys. Install it with one prompt, then analyse videos, spot trends in your niche and research competitors, safely.

guides.title: The Claude prompt that climbs your pages up Google
guides.description: Turn Claude into your own SEO agency: it checks your site every day, finds the pages stuck on page 2 of Google, and rewrites them to climb. Full prompt included, plus Google Search Console setup.

guides.title: Harvey: the open-source AI agent that finds you clients
guides.description: Set up Harvey with Claude Code to find businesses that fit your offer, write a personal cold email to each, watch your inbox and draft follow-ups, all on one dashboard. You approve every email.

guides.title: 5 websites that level up what you build with Claude
guides.description: Anime.js, Motion, Kokonut UI, Bklit UI and Manus: what each one does, when to use it, and the exact prompts to make Claude build animated, professional websites and dashboards.

guides.title: Build your own AI video editor with Claude Code
guides.description: Set up Claude Code with FFmpeg, Whisper, Hyperframes and yt-dlp, create a style sheet from reels you love, and edit raw footage into finished reels with captions, music and motion graphics. Every prompt included.

guides.title: The Parasite SEO playbook
guides.description: Reach the first page of Google, and get quoted by ChatGPT, without a website. Five methods: 2027 posts, Zenodo research, short LinkedIn articles, Gamma decks and helpful Reddit answers, plus a 14-day plan.

guides.title: Founder Skill: test your business before you spend a dollar
guides.description: Install the free Founder Skill in Claude and get an AI board of directors, marketing director and CFO. Then run your idea past 100 simulated customers to see who buys, who doesn't, and why.

guides.title: Dual Skill: make Claude and ChatGPT debate
guides.description: Bring ChatGPT into your Claude chat and make them pick apart each other's answers until only the best one is left. Includes getting an OpenAI API key safely and keeping costs low.
